WITH cust AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID=ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_c FROM cust GROUP BY Segment
),
avg AS (
  SELECT s.Segment, s.min_c * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM seg s JOIN cust c ON c.Segment=s.Segment AND c.total_consumption=s.min_c
  GROUP BY s.Segment, s.min_c
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM avg
